scope: Independent read-only review of completed installed lifecycle evidence, accepted artifact continuity and publication readiness.
observed_lifecycle: Installed 2.1.40 downloaded the exact accepted 2.1.41 ZIP and updater replaced the signed app. Root explicitly reopened the normal installed app; startup prepared the matching payload and daemon. Repair, restart, signature and 27 Doctor checks passed.

evidence_scope.installed_rendering: Root inspected actual installed-daemon Board and task popup via authorized StackOS browser; no console errors. Normal native app window presence was independently recorded by root.
evidence_scope.preservation: Reviewer compared before/final fingerprint arrays: exact identity-set equality, custody/configuration hashes and schema unchanged. This is not a claim that the entire live database was byte-identical.
evidence_scope.updater_and_desktop_code: No nonmetadata desktop changes since accepted 2.1.40; nine packaged Electron source hashes identical. Prior negative-feed evidence is reusable on unchanged updater code; no new negative-feed run is claimed.

recorded_limits.disposition: Unproven. Normal reopen was explicit; do not describe this run as a demonstrated automatic relaunch.
OS screenshot capture failed after bounded attempts; native window geometry restored. Installed-daemon rendering and native window presence are distinct evidence. Do not claim captured native pixels.
Initial splash data-URL ERR_ABORTED warning was observed; subsequent download/native update-downloaded and normal startup succeeded. No current product failure demonstrated by this warning alone.

authority: User authorized the release; root owns external staging, publication, promotion and final claims. This receipt authorizes no independent reviewer mutation.
remaining_obligation: After publication, verify exact versioned artifacts, blockmaps, stable DMG alias and update feed over public HTTPS against the accepted hashes before final closeout.
independence: No runtime/browser/provider/source/git changes or broad tests; reviewer inspected immutable package evidence, root lifecycle scripts and completed receipts, then wrote only this review receipt.
